title: New view of the Pillars of Creation — visible
credit: NASA, ESA/Hubble and the Hubble Heritage Team
license: CC BY 4.0 (ESA/Hubble image use policy, https://esahubble.org/copyright/); credit must be shown unaltered
band: Optical narrowband: [O III] 502 nm, H-alpha 657 nm, [S II] 673 nm
image_kind: processed multi-filter narrowband composite; display colours assigned per filter by the producers (the assignment is not listed on the source page)
processing_notes: Composite of three narrowband filters as published by ESA/Hubble; no further processing by this project.
derivative_operations: none: the file is used exactly as downloaded; at run time it is decoded and uploaded to the GPU as RGBA8 with mipmaps for display only
intended_use: Observation view reference panel; displayed unmodified with its credit line beside it, compared side by side with the STELLARIS procedural scene, which is labelled a conceptual visualization and not a reconstruction.
